trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista Boutique Stay
hotel.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00. Rest and travel time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take Disney's complimentary Magical Express (or budget Sunshine Flyer/rideshare) to your boutique stay near Magic Kingdom. Check in, freshen up, and get your park tickets and MagicBand sorted. Take a leisurely stroll around the Disney Springs area (free admission) to soak in the atmosphere, window shop, and explore the waterfront entertainment district.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Disney Springs for free live entertainment, street performers, and the vibrant evening atmosphere. Explore the shops and enjoy the illuminated waterfront. Wind down early to rest up for the full park days ahead.

meals.breakfast: Grab a meal at the airport before or after landing — look for grab-and-go options at MCO to save money.
meals.lunch: Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs — affordable, hearty sandwiches around $8–$10. One of the best budget-friendly quick-service spots on property.
meals.dinner: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — build-your-own pizza for around $10–$12. Quick, filling, and easy on the wallet.

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is intentionally light. Use this afternoon to pick up any groceries or snacks from a nearby Publix or Walmart (use Instacart or a quick rideshare) to stock your room with breakfast items and snacks — this alone can save $50–$100 over the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if you haven't already.

day_by_day.morning: Early arrival at Magic Kingdom — be at the gates 30 minutes before official opening (typically 9:00 AM) to take advantage of rope drop. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then dash to Seven Dwarfs Mine Train before the crowds build. Use the My Disney Experience app to monitor Lightning Lane availability and wait times in real time.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the morning rush, explore Fantasyland at a more relaxed pace — ride The Haunted Mansion, Pirates of the Caribbean, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Take a midday break during peak heat hours (12:00–2:00 PM) — find shade near Liberty Square or grab a cold treat. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check times in the app) which winds through Main Street U.S.A.
day_by_day.evening: Position yourself on Main Street U.S.A. or the hub area in front of Cinderella Castle for the EPCOT Forever or Magic Kingdom Fireworks (Happily Ever After / Disney Enchantment — confirm current show name in app). This is a must-see and completely included with park admission. Exit after the fireworks using the back exit toward Tomorrowland to avoid the main crowd surge.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast in your room using groceries purchased yesterday — cereal, fruit, granola bars, or yogurt to save $15–$20 per person.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — try the lobster roll or clam chowder bread bowl for around $12–$15. One of Magic Kingdom's best quick-service gems.
meals.dinner: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Cafe in Frontierland — burgers, fajita bowls around $12–$14. Load up at the free toppings bar (rice, beans, salsa, lettuce) to stretch your meal further.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is best tackled in two halves: ride the big-ticket attractions at rope drop, then slow down midday and return for evening entertainment. Bring a refillable water bottle — free ice water is available at any quick-service location. Wear comfortable walking shoes; expect 8–12 miles of walking.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at EPCOT. Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane — check app at 7:00 AM) and Test Track. Then explore Future World West — Soarin' Around the World and Living with the Land are both excellent and offer stunning visuals.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon walking the World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM. Stroll through the pavilions of Mexico, Norway (Frozen Ever After ride — join standby or Lightning Lane), China, Italy, Japan, and more. Each pavilion offers cultural entertainment, folk music, and unique architecture. This is a great low-cost entertainment stretch — no extra fees needed.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular (IllumiNations replacement — check current show name in 2027 via app). Watch from the World Showcase Lagoon for the best views. The show is included with park admission and is a spectacular end to the day.

meals.breakfast: Room breakfast — toast, fruit, and coffee/tea from your in-room supplies.
meals.lunch: Katsura Grill in the Japan Pavilion — sushi rolls, udon noodles, and teriyaki bowls for $12–$16. Excellent quality for a quick-service meal. Eat outdoors near the pagoda.
meals.dinner: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — rotating seasonal menu with sandwiches, grain bowls, and rotisserie chicken for $12–$15. One of EPCOT's most underrated and affordable dining spots.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive — wear comfortable shoes and pace yourself. The World Showcase is best in the afternoon and evening when pavilion entertainment is in full swing. If there's a Food & Wine or Flower & Garden Festival running in June 2027, take advantage of the small-plate food booths around the lagoon — great for sampling diverse cuisines at $4–$8 per item.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at Hollywood Studios. Arrive at rope drop and use the virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive experiences). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run in Galaxy's Edge. Explore the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge land thoroughly — the theming and atmosphere are extraordinary.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then experience Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in Sunset Boulevard. Catch a showing of Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check show schedule in app) — a free, thrilling live stunt show included with admission.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check showtimes — usually two shows on busy summer nights). Arrive 45–60 minutes early for a good seat. This dramatic water, fire, and projection show is completely included with park admission and is one of Disney's most beloved spectaculars.

meals.breakfast: Room breakfast — keep it simple and quick since rope drop timing is critical at Hollywood Studios.
meals.lunch: Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge — the Ronto Wrap (roasted pork, grilled sausage, tangy slaw) for around $13 is a fan favorite and very filling.
meals.dinner: Backlot Express near Echo Lake — burgers, chicken sandwiches, and salads for $11–$14. Spacious seating and a fun movie-prop themed interior. Great budget option before Fantasmic!

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the most ride-dense parks — a strategic rope drop is essential. Use the My Disney Experience app to monitor virtual queue release times for Rise of the Resistance (often at 7:00 AM and 1:00 PM). June is peak season so waits can be long — prioritize your must-dos early.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom day. Arrive at rope drop and head immediately to Pandora — The World of Avatar. Join the standby queue for Avatar: Flight of Passage (one of Disney's most breathtaking ride experiences) — waits can exceed 2 hours midday, so rope drop is essential. Then ride Na'vi River Journey in Pandora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — ride Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in morning/early afternoon for active animals) and walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail. Then head to Asia for Expedition Everest (a thrilling roller coaster with a surprising backwards section) and Kali River Rapids if you don't mind getting wet. DinoLand U.S.A. offers DINOSAUR ride for more thrills.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Rivers of Light or the current nighttime spectacular (verify 2027 schedule). The Tree of Life Awakenings — where the iconic Tree of Life is illuminated with projected animal spirits — happens throughout the evening and is a magical, free experience. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks, so plan your evening accordingly.

meals.breakfast: Room breakfast — pack extra snacks in a small bag for the park (allowed in Disney parks).
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney's best quick-service restaurants. Grain bowls, protein bowls with bold flavors for $14–$17. Worth every penny and very filling.
meals.dinner: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken for $13–$16. Outdoor waterfront seating with beautiful views of the park. Excellent budget-friendly BBQ.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. Bring a light poncho (buy one before the trip — in-park ponchos cost $12+) if riding Kali River Rapids. The park has a lush, immersive jungle atmosphere unlike any other Disney park — take time to explore the walking trails and hidden details.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park for a second visit — recommended: Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for anything you missed, OR use this morning for a relaxed pool day at your hotel. If revisiting Magic Kingdom, use this morning to ride anything with shorter waits (midweek mornings are generally less crowded). Alternatively, explore the free resort hotel lobbies — Disney's Grand Floridian, Polynesian, and Wilderness Lodge are stunning and open to all guests.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs free afternoon — explore the massive entertainment complex with no park ticket required. Browse World of Disney (the largest Disney character merchandise store), check out the LEGO Store, Splitsville Luxury Lanes (bowling — paid), and enjoy the waterfront atmosphere. This is a great low-cost or no-cost activity.
day_by_day.evening: Dinner and entertainment at Disney Springs. Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater if desired, or enjoy the free live music performances throughout the Springs. This is a great relaxed evening before your final full park day.

meals.breakfast: Sleep in and enjoy a proper room breakfast — scrambled eggs, toast, fruit, and juice from your grocery supplies.
meals.lunch: The Polite Pig at Disney Springs — BBQ sandwiches, smoked meats, and craft sides for $13–$16. A local Orlando favorite with great flavor.
meals.dinner: Wolfgang Puck Bar & Grill at Disney Springs — slightly upscale but with affordable bar menu options ($12–$18). Alternatively, Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri offers rotisserie chicken tenders with 22 dipping sauces for around $10–$13 — great budget option.

day_by_day.notes: Day 6 is intentionally flexible and lower intensity — use it to recharge before your final park day. Disney Springs is completely free to enter and offers hours of entertainment, dining, and shopping without a park ticket. It's also a great place to buy last-minute souvenirs, often at lower prices than inside the parks.

day_by_day.morning: Final park day — choose your personal favorite or the park with experiences you haven't yet completed. Recommended: EPCOT or Hollywood Studios for anything missed. Arrive at rope drop one final time and prioritize your absolute must-do rides. This is your last chance to ride anything you loved or missed during the week.
day_by_day.afternoon: Wrap up your park visit by 2:00–3:00 PM to allow time for returning to the hotel, packing, and any final souvenir shopping. If you have time, revisit Main Street U.S.A. at Magic Kingdom for a final stroll and photos in front of Cinderella Castle — a classic Disney memory.
day_by_day.evening: Return to hotel, pack, and prepare for departure. Enjoy a final dinner near the resort. Reflect on an incredible week at Walt Disney World. Arrange your transportation to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight.

meals.breakfast: Final room breakfast — use up any remaining grocery supplies to minimize waste and save money on your last morning.
meals.lunch: Quick-service meal inside your chosen park — revisit a favorite spot from the week or try something new. Budget $12–$15 per person.
meals.dinner: 4 Rivers Smokehouse (near Disney World on US-192) — outstanding local BBQ with generous portions at $12–$16. A beloved Central Florida institution and excellent value for a final celebratory meal. Or opt for a simple grocery/takeout meal back at the hotel to save for your journey home.

day_by_day.notes: Budget tip summary for the week: Packing your own breakfast items and snacks saves approximately $200–$400 for a family of four over 7 days. Free refillable water at quick-service locations saves on drink costs. Disney Springs entertainment is entirely free. Rope drop strategy reduces the need for paid Lightning Lane upgrades. Total estimated park dining budget per adult: $30–$45/day eating strategically at quick-service locations. Always check the My Disney Experience app for current wait times, show schedules, and any special events running during your visit in June 2027.

day_by_day.morning: Flight arrives at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Travel from Orlando International Airport to your boutique stay at Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista. Check-in, freshen up, and get oriented with the resort map and park apps.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs for a relaxed first afternoon. Explore the outdoor waterfront shopping district, browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), and soak in the atmosphere without the pressure of a full park day. Great way to ease into the Disney magic after travel.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Evening — enjoy live street performances, browse the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater marquee, visit the LEGO Store, and take a leisurely stroll along the waterfront. Perfect low-key first night to recover from travel.

meals.breakfast: Grab something light at the airport before landing or snack on the plane.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at Disney Springs — try D-Luxe Burger for a mid-range, satisfying meal with craft burgers and milkshakes.
meals.dinner: Dinner at The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — waterfront dining with seafood, steaks, and pasta in a relaxed nautical setting. Mid-range pricing with a festive atmosphere.

day_by_day.notes: Download the My Disney Experience app before arrival. Link your resort reservation and set up MagicMobile on your phone. Purchase Genie+ for the following day if planning on hitting major attractions. Keep the first evening light — jet lag and travel fatigue are real!

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure — arrive at rope drop (park typically opens at 9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain before crowds build. Then move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane if available. Explore Cinderella Castle and meet characters early.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — ride Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (typically around 3:00 PM) from a shaded spot on Main Street U.S.A. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed — the resort is close by.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening magic — enjoy lower crowd levels after dinner. Watch the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (typically around 9:00 PM). This is a bucket-list Disney moment not to be missed.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at your resort before rope drop — grab grab-and-go items or a quick continental breakfast to save time.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — counter-service New England-style seafood and sandwiches at a mid-range price. Try the clam chowder and lobster roll.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland — prix-fixe dinner in the enchanted Beast's Castle. Book well in advance via My Disney Experience. A memorable mid-range splurge perfectly suited for the experience.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes — Magic Kingdom involves significant walking. Use the Genie+ Lightning Lane selections strategically starting at 7:00 AM. Bring a portable phone charger. Arrive 30 minutes before park opening to clear security and be at the front of the rope drop crowd.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience. Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of the most immersive rides ever built). Then visit Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore the Batuu marketplace and enjoy the themed environment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue at Hollywood Studios — visit Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then head to Sunset Boulevard for Rock 'n' Roller Coaster and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Catch a showing of Fantasmic! (check schedule) in the evening queue area if timing works.
day_by_day.evening: Build Your Own Lightsaber at Savi's Workshop in Galaxy's Edge (book in advance — approximately $299 per lightsaber, a premium splurge worth considering for Star Wars fans). Alternatively, enjoy the Oga's Cantina experience for themed cocktails and mocktails in an immersive alien bar setting.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at your resort or pick up a Ronto Wrap from Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge — a unique roasted pork and egg wrap served in a warm pita. Iconic and delicious.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — counter-service comfort food with totchos, grilled cheese sandwiches, and lunch box tarts. Affordable and fun.
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — eat in vintage cars under a starry sky while watching classic sci-fi movie clips. A uniquely Disney mid-range dining experience.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations sell out weeks in advance — book immediately via My Disney Experience if interested. Rise of the Resistance virtual queue or Lightning Lane purchases are essential. Download the Star Wars Datapad feature in the Play Disney Parks app to interact with Galaxy's Edge elements.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and resort morning — take a leisurely breakfast and enjoy the resort pool and amenities. This mid-trip rest day is essential for recharging, especially with family. Explore the resort grounds, visit the beach area near the Contemporary or Polynesian (if accessible), or simply relax.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — arrive at EPCOT around noon. Begin at Future World (now called World Discovery/World Nature) and ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind or Test Track. Then enter World Showcase and begin your cultural journey around the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Continue the EPCOT World Showcase experience into the evening — sample food and beverages from multiple countries (Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, Canada). Watch the EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed resort breakfast — visit your hotel's main dining area or grab pastries and coffee from a resort marketplace.
meals.lunch: Graze through World Showcase pavilions — try a School Bread pastry in Norway, spring rolls in China, and a pretzel in Germany. Budget $25–$40 per person for a satisfying multicultural lunch crawl.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — hibachi-style tableside cooking with fresh meats and vegetables. A lively, interactive, mid-range dinner experience perfect for families.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, making this a perfect day to sleep in slightly. If EPCOT has a seasonal food festival running (Food & Wine, Flower & Garden, etc.), take full advantage — additional food booths and entertainment are added throughout the park.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Typhoon Lagoon Water Park Day — arrive at opening (typically 10:00 AM or earlier in peak summer season). Head straight to Crush 'n' Gusher, the most popular water coaster, before lines build. Then enjoy the wave pool — Typhoon Lagoon's wave pool is one of the largest in the world with massive surf waves.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue at Typhoon Lagoon — enjoy Castaway Creek (the lazy river), family raft rides like Ketchakiddee Creek for younger kids, and tube slides like Humunga Kowabunga for thrill seekers. Rent a private beach cabana if budget allows for a shaded home base ($400–$500/day, split among a group).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a shower and change, then head out for a relaxed evening. Visit Disney Springs for shopping, entertainment, and dinner. Browse unique stores like Anthropologie, Zara, or the NBA Experience.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before heading to the water park — fuel up with a hearty meal.
meals.lunch: Leaning Palms at Typhoon Lagoon — counter-service burgers, hot dogs, salads, and sandwiches right at the water park. Affordable and convenient. Budget $15–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: Splitsville Luxury Lanes at Disney Springs — bowling alley restaurant with a surprisingly excellent menu of sushi, flatbreads, burgers, and cocktails. Fun, lively atmosphere at mid-range prices.

day_by_day.notes: Apply and reapply waterproof sunscreen generously — June in Florida means intense UV exposure. Bring water shoes, as some surfaces get extremely hot. Arrive early as Typhoon Lagoon can reach capacity on hot summer days and temporarily stop admissions. Water park admission is separate from park tickets unless you have a park hopper plus option.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Magic Kingdom for any remaining attractions or to re-experience favorites. Focus on Adventureland — Jungle Cruise (recently updated with new scenes), Swiss Family Treehouse, and Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room. Then visit Liberty Square and Frontierland for a more relaxed pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at Disney's Animal Kingdom (optional park hop) — if you have a Park Hopper ticket, hop over to Animal Kingdom for Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora: The World of Avatar (one of Disney's most breathtaking rides). Also enjoy Kilimanjaro Safaris for a real wildlife experience.
day_by_day.evening: Grand finale evening back at Magic Kingdom — ride any remaining must-dos, shop Main Street U.S.A. for souvenirs, and watch the Main Street Electrical Parade if scheduled. End the night with one final viewing of the fireworks spectacular for a magical send-off.

meals.breakfast: Crystal Palace at Magic Kingdom — character dining breakfast with Winnie the Pooh and friends. A beloved family tradition at mid-range pricing. Book in advance.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora at Animal Kingdom (if park hopping) — healthy bowls with proteins and grains in a beautifully themed environment. One of Disney's best counter-service options.
meals.dinner: Tony's Town Square Restaurant at Magic Kingdom — Italian-American cuisine inspired by Lady and the Tramp, located at the end of Main Street. Pasta, chicken, and seafood at mid-range prices with a festive atmosphere.

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically one of the busiest days at Disney parks — use Genie+ and Lightning Lane selections aggressively. Consider arriving at rope drop and using the mid-afternoon lull (2–4 PM) to return to the resort for rest before the evening rush. Book all dining reservations 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely final morning — enjoy a relaxed resort breakfast and begin packing. Take a final stroll around the resort grounds to soak in the Disney atmosphere. Visit any resort gift shops for last-minute souvenirs. Check out of the resort (standard checkout is typically 11:00 AM; request late checkout if available).
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure flight time — if time allows, visit Disney Springs one final time for any remaining shopping or a farewell treat. Visit Gideon's Bakehouse for their legendary massive cookies (expect a wait, but worth it). Pick up Disney-branded snacks and treats to bring home.
day_by_day.evening: Transfer to Orlando International Airport for departure. Arrive at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight, as MCO can be busy. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic!

meals.breakfast: Chef Mickey's at Disney's Contemporary Resort — iconic character dining breakfast with Mickey, Minnie, and friends. A celebratory final morning feast. Book well in advance.
meals.lunch: Disney Springs farewell lunch at Wine Bar George — Florida's only master sommelier-led restaurant with shareable plates, flatbreads, and charcuterie at approachable mid-range prices.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at MCO or an early dinner at Disney Springs before heading to the airport — keep it simple for the travel day.

day_by_day.notes: Disney's Magical Express (now replaced by Mears Connect or private transfers) should be booked in advance for airport transportation — budget approximately $32–$36 per person each way. Store luggage at the resort's bell services if checkout is before your departure time. Consider purchasing a Disney gift card with any remaining resort credit to use at home for future Disney purchases.

A perfect blend of food, culture, and family entertainment.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Evening
experiences.description: Spend a lively evening at Disney Springs, Disney's outdoor waterfront shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Enjoy world-class dining at restaurants like The BOATHOUSE with stunning waterfront views, watch live street performances, visit the House of Blues for live music, and explore unique shops. A relaxed, budget-friendly family evening with a vibrant lakeside atmosphere.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Resort Check-In: Flight LH lands at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Upon landing, arrange private Disney Magical Express or pre-booked luxury car transfer to the Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort boutique stay. Enjoy a seamless VIP check-in experience with dedicated concierge service.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Exploration & Magic Kingdom Orientation: After settling into your luxury suite, take a leisurely stroll through the resort grounds. Head to Magic Kingdom for a late-afternoon visit — enjoy Cinderella Castle views, a relaxed ride on the iconic carousel, and a first look at Main Street U.S.A. decorated for the season. Purchase or activate your Disney MagicBand+ for seamless park access.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Fireworks & Enchanted Stroll: Stay in Magic Kingdom for the legendary 'Disney Enchantment' or 'Happily Ever After' nighttime spectacular fireworks show over Cinderella Castle. Enjoy the park's magical evening atmosphere, character meet-and-greets, and a final walk down Main Street U.S.A. before returning to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy in-flight dining or grab a light snack at Orlando International Airport's premium lounge upon arrival.
meals.lunch: The Plaza Restaurant (Magic Kingdom): A charming Victorian-style table-service restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. offering elevated American classics — perfect for a relaxed first meal in the park.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table (Magic Kingdom): A once-in-a-lifetime fine dining experience inside Cinderella Castle. Enjoy a prix-fixe menu of premium American cuisine with character appearances from Disney princesses. Advance reservation strongly recommended.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book Cinderella's Royal Table well in advance (up to 60 days) as it sells out quickly. Activate Disney MagicBand+ and set up Lightning Lane Multi Pass on the My Disney Experience app upon arrival. Request early park entry privileges as a resort guest — this grants 30 minutes of access before regular park opening starting Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure — Morning Session: Leverage Early Theme Park Entry (30 min before official opening) as a resort guest. Head straight to the most popular attractions: Tron Lightcycle / Run, Space Mountain, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane Individual selections. Enjoy a classic ride on Pirates of the Caribbean and the Haunted Mansion with minimal wait times in the early hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure — Afternoon Session: After a midday lunch break, return for afternoon adventures. Experience Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, 'it's a small world', and Peter Pan's Flight. Take time for a royal meet-and-greet experience with Mickey & Minnie at Town Square Theater. Browse unique luxury merchandise and personalized keepsakes along Main Street U.S.A.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Dessert Party & Fireworks VIP Experience: Book the 'Disney Enchantment Dessert Party' for exclusive reserved viewing of the nighttime spectacular from a premium location near the Castle Hub. Enjoy unlimited premium desserts, beverages, and a dedicated viewing area with unobstructed fireworks views.

meals.breakfast: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Magic Kingdom): Dine in the enchanted Beast's Castle ballroom. The breakfast prix-fixe menu features French-inspired pastries, eggs, and specialty coffees — a truly immersive premium experience.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House (Liberty Square): A quick-service gem with elevated seafood options including lobster rolls and clam chowder — ideal for a lighter midday refuel during a full park day.
meals.dinner: The Crystal Palace (Magic Kingdom): A stunning Victorian conservatory offering a Winnie the Pooh character dining buffet with premium carved meats, fresh seafood, and gourmet sides — elegant and family-friendly.

day_by_day.notes: Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass aggressively today — book your first selection as soon as the park opens and chain selections throughout the day. Bring sunscreen and portable fans as June temperatures in Orlando can reach 90°F+ with high humidity. The Dessert Party requires a separate reservation and is a premium add-on cost.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Morning Blitz: Arrive at park opening using Early Entry. Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — secure a boarding group or Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance, the most immersive theme park attraction ever built. Follow up with Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for a hands-on piloting experience. Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom, hand-crafted lightsaber (advance reservation required — a premium $250+ experience).
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios Highlights: Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios — experience Tower of Terror, Slinky Dog Dash (Toy Story Land), and Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular or a live entertainment show. Browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities for rare Star Wars collectibles and luxury memorabilia.
day_by_day.evening: Fantasmic! VIP Dining Package & Nighttime Show: Book the Fantasmic! Dining Package at Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater or Hollywood & Vine for guaranteed reserved seating at the iconic nighttime water, fire, and projection spectacular. The show features Mickey Mouse in an epic battle of imagination — a must-see Hollywood Studios finale.

meals.breakfast: Resort in-room dining or The Wave of American Flavors (Contemporary Resort): A short monorail ride away, this restaurant offers a health-conscious, locally-sourced breakfast menu in an upscale setting.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge): Immersive Star Wars-themed quick service with surprisingly elevated dishes including Smoked Kaadu Ribs and exotic galactic beverages — the best themed dining in Galaxy's Edge.
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant (Hollywood Studios): A uniquely cinematic experience — dine in vintage convertible cars under a starlit sky watching classic sci-fi B-movie clips. Menu features premium burgers, steaks, and cocktails.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building experience must be reserved in advance via My Disney Experience — slots fill up months ahead. Budget approximately $250 per lightsaber. The Droid Depot (build your own droid, ~$120) is another premium add-on worth considering. Fantasmic! Dining Package reservations should be made 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Typhoon Lagoon Water Park — Morning Splash: Arrive at rope drop for Typhoon Lagoon. Reserve a premium private cabana (book in advance — limited availability) for an exclusive, shaded retreat with dedicated attendant service, complimentary snacks, and priority access to chairs. Start with Crush 'n' Gusher water coaster and Humunga Kowabunga speed slides before the park fills up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Typhoon Lagoon Relaxation & Adventure: Spend the afternoon floating the 2,100-foot Castaway Creek lazy river, riding the wave pool (one of the world's largest), and enjoying family-friendly slides like Ketchakiddee Creek. Take a break in your private cabana with in-cabana food and beverage service. Optional: Book a private surf lesson during 'Shark Reef' snorkeling experience.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Evening: Transition from the water park to Disney Springs for a vibrant evening of shopping, entertainment, and world-class dining. Browse luxury boutiques including Pandora, Lilly Pulitzer, and the massive World of Disney flagship store. Catch live entertainment at the Marketplace Stage or enjoy a cocktail at a waterfront bar.

meals.breakfast: Leaning Palms (Typhoon Lagoon): Grab fresh fruit, specialty pastries, and premium coffee at the park's main quick-service location upon arrival — light and energizing for a water park day.
meals.lunch: Typhoon Tilly's (Typhoon Lagoon): Enjoy elevated waterside dining with fresh seafood, fish tacos, and tropical cocktails — order cabana service for the ultimate luxury experience.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando (Disney Springs): A sophisticated modern steakhouse with a vibrant atmosphere. Indulge in USDA prime dry-aged steaks, fresh seafood towers, and craft cocktails. One of Orlando's finest fine-dining experiences — perfect for a premium evening at Disney Springs.

day_by_day.notes: Private cabana rental at Typhoon Lagoon starts at approximately $400–$600/day and must be reserved well in advance — contact Disney's premium services line or your concierge. Bring water shoes as park surfaces get extremely hot in June. Disney Springs is free to enter and offers complimentary parking. STK Orlando accepts reservations via OpenTable.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Morning: Arrive at EPCOT for Early Entry. Begin with Future World (now called World Discovery/World Nature/World Celebration) — experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane), Remy's Ratatouille Adventure, and Test Track. Grab your first passport stamp at the World Showcase as pavilions open at 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Cultural Immersion: Embark on a self-guided or guided cultural tour of the 11 World Showcase pavilions. Start in Mexico (La Cava del Tequila tasting), move through Norway, China, Germany, Italy, and America. Enjoy artisan shopping, cultural performances, and authentic cuisine samples. Book the 'EPCOT Food & Wine Festival' experiences if visiting during festival season (typically August–November — check dates).
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT HARMONIOUS Nighttime Spectacular: Remain in EPCOT for the grand 'HARMONIOUS' nighttime show on World Showcase Lagoon — one of the largest nighttime spectaculars ever created for Disney parks, featuring massive floating set pieces, fountains, pyrotechnics, and projections celebrating world cultures.

meals.breakfast: Kringla Bakeri Og Kafe (Norway Pavilion, EPCOT): Arrive as World Showcase opens and enjoy authentic Norwegian pastries, school bread, and specialty coffees in a charming Scandinavian setting.
meals.lunch: Chefs de France (France Pavilion, EPCOT): An authentic French brasserie created in partnership with legendary French chefs. Enjoy croque monsieurs, French onion soup, and classic bistro entrées in an elegant Parisian atmosphere.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul (France Pavilion, EPCOT): EPCOT's most prestigious fine-dining restaurant — a Michelin-caliber French restaurant on the second floor of the France Pavilion. Enjoy a multi-course prix-fixe menu with sommelier-curated wine pairings. The pinnacle of Disney dining.

day_by_day.notes: La Cava del Tequila in the Mexico Pavilion is one of Disney's most beloved hidden gems — arrive early or expect a wait. Monsieur Paul requires advance reservations (60 days) and is considered one of the best restaurants in all of Walt Disney World. Consider booking an EPCOT International Gateway entry for a back entrance from the EPCOT area resort hotels. The France Pavilion also features the Impressions de France film and a new Remy's Ratatouille Adventure ride.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom — Morning Safari & Avatar: Begin with Early Entry at Animal Kingdom. Head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar: experience Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride — Lightning Lane Individual strongly recommended) and Na'vi River Journey. The bioluminescent beauty of Pandora is extraordinary, especially in morning light. Follow up with Kilimanjaro Safaris for a live African savanna wildlife experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Animal Kingdom Exploration & Entertainment: Explore the Maharajah Jungle Trek and Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for up-close wildlife encounters. Catch the Festival of the Lion King live stage show — a Broadway-caliber performance. Experience Expedition Everest – Legend of the Forbidden Mountain and DINOSAUR. Browse the premium Zuri's Sweets Shop and Dawa Market for unique artisan souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Return — Cirque du Soleil & Farewell Dinner: End the penultimate evening with a spectacular performance of 'Drawn to Life' by Cirque du Soleil at Disney Springs — a one-of-a-kind acrobatic show celebrating the art of Disney animation. Follow with a final luxurious dinner at one of Disney Springs' premier restaurants.

meals.breakfast: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom): One of Disney's most artistically stunning restaurants, inspired by global travel and exploration. The breakfast or early lunch menu features globally-inspired premium dishes in a gallery-like setting with original expedition artwork.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen (Pandora, Animal Kingdom): The best quick-service restaurant in Walt Disney World — enjoy customizable bowls with premium proteins, grains, and sauces in a stunning Avatar-themed environment.
meals.dinner: Paddlefish (Disney Springs): A stunning multi-deck seafood restaurant aboard a steamboat on the Disney Springs waterway. Enjoy fresh Maine lobster, premium oysters, and signature seafood platters with panoramic waterfront views — an elegant and memorable evening.

day_by_day.notes: Flight of Passage Lightning Lane Individual selection sells out within minutes of park opening — purchase the moment the option becomes available (7:00 AM on the My Disney Experience app). Cirque du Soleil 'Drawn to Life' tickets should be reserved in advance — premium seating categories offer the best sightlines. Consider the VIP Tier for Cirque for complimentary beverages and priority seating.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely Resort Morning & Magic Kingdom Farewell: Enjoy a slow, luxurious final morning at the resort — indulge in a premium in-room breakfast delivered by concierge service. Take a final stroll through the resort grounds, capture photos of the iconic Magic Kingdom skyline from the resort, and complete any last-minute souvenir shopping at the resort's boutique shops.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Bucket List Rides & Farewell Tour: Return to Magic Kingdom for a final afternoon of must-do experiences. Ride any remaining favorites — Tron Lightcycle / Run, Splash Mountain (if operational), or the Liberty Belle Riverboat for a relaxing scenic cruise. Visit the Emporium on Main Street U.S.A. for premium Disney keepsakes and personalized merchandise. Enjoy one final character meet-and-greet for lasting memories.
day_by_day.evening: Departure Preparation & Resort Farewell Dinner: Return to the resort for a final elegant dinner before preparing for departure. Pack, arrange checkout with concierge, and organize luxury private car transfer or Disney's Magical Express to Orlando International Airport for your departing flight.

meals.breakfast: In-room resort concierge breakfast: Order a curated luxury breakfast spread delivered to your suite — fresh fruit, premium pastries, made-to-order eggs, fresh-squeezed juices, and specialty coffees. The ultimate relaxed farewell morning.
meals.lunch: Liberty Tree Tavern (Magic Kingdom, Liberty Square): A warm, colonial-style table-service restaurant serving a family-style 'Patriot's Platter' feast with rotisserie meats, stuffing, and seasonal vegetables — hearty and satisfying for a final park afternoon.
meals.dinner: California Grill (Contemporary Resort): The crown jewel of Disney resort dining — perched on the 15th floor of the Contemporary Resort with panoramic views of Magic Kingdom and the Seven Seas Lagoon. Enjoy a world-class menu of California-inspired cuisine with an award-winning wine list, and watch the Magic Kingdom fireworks from the rooftop observation deck as your grand Disney farewell.

day_by_day.notes: California Grill offers a special fireworks viewing experience — guests can step outside to the observation deck during the Magic Kingdom nighttime show. Reservations are essential (60 days in advance) and this dinner is the perfect luxury send-off for the trip. Confirm checkout time with the resort concierge and arrange luggage storage if your flight departs late. Request a 'farewell' amenity from the concierge — many Disney luxury resorts offer complimentary touches for departing guests.
